patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts for product displays and feature sections, often pairing large imagery with concise text blocks.
Extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif typography is used for key section titles and the hero brand name, creating a dominant visual presence.
A high-contrast dark mode palette is used throughout, featuring very dark backgrounds, white text, and minimal, subtle accent colors.
Large, fixed-position text elements (like 'VIBOR' and 'GENERAL CATALOGUE') parallax slowly as the user scrolls, with foreground content moving over them, creating a layered depth effect.
Full-width sections are used to introduce product categories and features, often with a dark background and prominent product photography.

technique_notes: The top navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Massive, bold text elements are positioned to appear fixed or scroll at a much slower rate than the main content, allowing other page elements to scroll over them to create a layered parallax effect.
Sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, enhancing the scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy sans-serif headings (~10x body text) are contrasted with smaller, regular-weight body text and uppercase labels, creating a dramatic and bold hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular elements with minimal to no corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical spacing between sections and balanced spacing within content blocks, contributing to a clean, uncluttered feel).

standout: The most distinctive design element is the dramatic use of massive, fixed-position typography that acts as a background layer, with other page content scrolling over it. This creates a strong sense of depth and makes the brand name and key messages visually dominant throughout the user's scroll.
